richDetail: [TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]Not shaking or moving (used in the book when Griffith tells everyone to keep the dragon calm while putting on the saddle)[/EN][CN]平稳的；稳定的（书中指格里菲斯让大家给龙装马鞍时，让龙保持不摇晃）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈstedɪ/[/PH][DU]"Steady now," warned Griffith, the king's wizard.|(原文例句)“现在稳住，”国王的巫师格里菲斯警告道。[/DU][DU]Keep steady when you stand on the dragon's back.|站在龙背上时要保持平稳。[/DU][DU]The little bird stayed steady on the thin branch.|小鸟稳稳地停在细树枝上。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/steady.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To make something stop shaking or moving[/EN][CN]使平稳；稳住[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]Bo steadied the saddle before putting it on Shu.|波在给舒装马鞍前先稳住了它。[/DU][DU]She steadied the bowl with both hands.|她用双手稳住了碗。[/DU][DU]The hiker steadied himself against the rock.|徒步旅行者靠着石头稳住了身体。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]steady hand|平稳的手[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]You need a steady hand to feed the small dragon.|喂小龙需要手稳。[/EX][EX]The artist has a steady hand to draw fine lines.|艺术家有一双平稳的手来画细线。[/EX][C]a steady hand for painting|画画用的平稳的手[/C][C]a steady hand for cooking|做饭用的平稳的手[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]steady oneself|稳住自己[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]He steadied himself on the dragon's saddle.|他在龙的马鞍上稳住了自己。[/EX][EX]She steadied herself when the wind blew hard.|大风刮起时，她稳住了自己。[/EX][C]steady oneself against the wind|逆风稳住自己[/C][C]steady oneself on the ladder|在梯子上稳住自己[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The dragon flew at a steady pace through the sky.[POS]adj.[/POS]|龙以平稳的速度在空中飞行。[/EX][EX]The water in the lake is steady on calm days.[POS]adj.[/POS]|无风的日子里，湖面很平稳。[/EX][EX]He steadied the box so it wouldn't fall off the table.[POS]v.[/POS]|他稳住了盒子，不让它从桌子上掉下来。[/EX][EX]The teacher steadied the student's hand to write neatly.[POS]v.[/POS]|老师稳住学生的手，让他写得工整。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]不要混淆 steady 和 stable！steady 侧重“动作、状态不摇晃”，stable 侧重“结构、局势稳定”，比如“稳定的工作”是 a stable job，不是 a steady job。[/ERR][ERR]作动词时，直接接宾语，不能说“steady on sth”，正确表达：steady the saddle（稳住马鞍）。[/ERR][ERR]作形容词时，修饰名词要放在前面，不能说“a hand steady”，正确表达：a steady hand（平稳的手）。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]A seat for riding a dragon or horse (used in the book when the Dragon Masters put seats on their dragons for travel)[/EN][CN]马鞍；鞍具（书中指龙法师们给龙装的供骑行的座位）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈsædl/[/PH][DU]We have never tried putting a saddle on a dragon before.|(原文例句)我们以前从未试过给龙装马鞍。[/DU][DU]The cowboy put a saddle on his horse before riding.|牛仔骑马前给马装上了马鞍。[/DU][DU]The dragon's saddle is made of soft cloth.|龙的鞍具是用柔软的布料做的。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/saddle.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To put a saddle on an animal[/EN][CN]给……装马鞍；套上鞍具[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]Bo saddled Shu carefully to avoid hurting her.|(原文相关例句)波小心地给舒装鞍具，以免弄伤她。[/DU][DU]They saddled the horses early in the morning for the trip.|他们一大早给马装鞍，准备出发。[/DU][DU]Can you help me saddle the pony?|你能帮我给小马装鞍具吗？[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]put a saddle on|给……装马鞍[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The Dragon Masters put a saddle on each dragon.|龙法师们给每条龙都装了马鞍。[/EX][EX]She put a saddle on her pet goat for fun.|她给宠物山羊装了鞍具，玩得很开心。[/EX][C]put a saddle on a dragon|给龙装马鞍[/C][C]put a saddle on a horse|给马装马鞍[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]ride with a saddle|骑着带鞍具的……[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Riding with a saddle is safer than riding without.|骑着带鞍具的动物比没装鞍具更安全。[/EX][EX]The knight rode with a shiny saddle on his horse.|骑士骑着带有闪亮鞍具的马。[/EX][C]ride a dragon with a saddle|骑着带鞍具的龙[/C][C]ride a horse with a saddle|骑着带鞍具的马[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The saddle on Vulcan was red like his scales.[POS]n.[/POS]|伏尔坎背上的鞍具和他的鳞片一样红。[/EX][EX]We need to clean the saddle after riding in the mud.[POS]n.[/POS]|在泥地里骑完后，我们需要清理鞍具。[/EX][EX]He saddled the dragon quickly and climbed on its back.[POS]v.[/POS]|他快速给龙装完鞍具，爬上了龙背。[/EX][EX]She saddled her toy dragon and pretended to fly.[POS]v.[/POS]|她给玩具龙装了鞍具，假装飞行。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]作名词时，复数形式是 saddles，不能说“a saddle of dragon”，正确表达是 a dragon's saddle（龙的马鞍）。[/ERR][ERR]作动词时，直接接宾语，不能说“saddle on the dragon”，正确表达：saddle the dragon（给龙装鞍具）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆 saddle 和 seat！saddle 是“专门用于骑马/龙的鞍具”，seat 是泛指“座位”，比如“椅子上的座位”是 a seat on the chair。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]A fastener for a strap or belt (used in the book when Bo uses the fastener to fix the saddle on Shu)[/EN][CN]带扣；搭扣（书中指波用来固定龙鞍具的扣件）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈbʌkl/[/PH][DU]Bo, bring the buckle under Shu's belly.|(原文例句)波，把带扣绕到舒的肚子底下。[/DU][DU]The buckle on my backpack keeps the strap tight.|我背包上的带扣让带子保持紧绷。[/DU][DU]The cowboy's belt has a silver buckle.|牛仔的腰带上有一个银色的带扣。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/buckle.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To fasten with a buckle[/EN][CN]扣上；扣紧[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]Bo buckled the saddle strap tightly under Shu's belly.|(原文相关例句)波把鞍具的带子在舒的肚子底下扣紧。[/DU][DU]She buckled her shoes before running outside.|她跑出去前扣好了鞋子的搭扣。[/DU][DU]Can you help me buckle this belt?|你能帮我扣上这条腰带吗？[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]fasten the buckle|扣上带扣[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Fasten the buckle before riding the dragon.|骑龙前把带扣扣紧。[/EX][EX]He fastened the buckle on his suitcase tightly.|他把行李箱上的带扣紧紧扣上。[/EX][C]fasten a belt buckle|扣上腰带扣[/C][C]fasten a saddle buckle|扣上鞍具带扣[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]buckle up|系好安全带（口语常用）[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Buckle up before the car starts.|车启动前系好安全带。[/EX][EX]The teacher told the kids to buckle up on the school bus.|老师让孩子们在校车上系好安全带。[/EX][C]buckle up for safety|为安全系好安全带[/C][C]buckle up quickly|快速系好安全带[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The buckle on the saddle is made of strong metal.[POS]n.[/POS]|鞍具上的带扣是用坚固的金属做的。[/EX][EX]I lost the buckle of my favorite bag.|我弄丢了我最喜欢的包的带扣。[/EX][EX]She buckled the strap so the bag wouldn't fall off.|她扣紧了带子，这样包就不会掉下来了。[/EX][EX]He buckled his helmet before riding the bike.|他骑自行车前扣紧了头盔。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]不要混淆 buckle 和 button！buckle 是“带扣”，用于固定带子；button 是“纽扣”，用于固定衣服，比如“衬衫纽扣”是 shirt button。[/ERR][ERR]作动词时，“扣上带扣”是 buckle the buckle（正确），不要重复表达为“buckle the fastener”（错误）。[/ERR][ERR]作名词时，复数形式是 buckles，不能说“bucklees”（错误拼写）。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To make something more tight (used in the book when Bo makes the saddle buckle more firm on Shu)[/EN][CN]拉紧；拧紧；使变紧（书中指波把舒身上的鞍具带扣拉得更紧）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/ˈtaɪtn/[/PH][DU]Now tighten the buckle. Good!|(原文例句)现在把带扣拉紧。很好！[/DU][DU]Tighten the rope so the box won't move.|拉紧绳子，让箱子不会动。[/DU][DU]Can you tighten this screw with a screwdriver?|你能用螺丝刀把这个螺丝拧紧吗？[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/tighten.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To become more tight[/EN][CN]变紧；收紧[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The belt tightens up when you pull it hard.|你用力一拉，腰带就会收紧。[/DU][DU]The cold air makes the rubber band tighten up.|冷空气让橡皮筋变紧了。[/DU][DU]The rope tightens as the boat moves away.|船开走时，绳子会变紧。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]tighten a buckle|拉紧带扣[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Bo tightened the buckle to keep the saddle in place.|波拉紧了带扣，让鞍具固定住。[/EX][EX]She tightened the buckle on her shoes before walking.|她走路前拉紧了鞋子的搭扣。[/EX][C]tighten a saddle buckle|拉紧鞍具带扣[/C][C]tighten a belt buckle|拉紧腰带扣[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]tighten up|变紧；收紧[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The muscles in his legs tightened up after running.|跑步后他腿上的肌肉收紧了。[/EX][EX]The rope tightens up when the wind blows.|刮风时，绳子会变紧。[/EX][C]tighten up the rules|收紧规则[/C][C]tighten up the budget|收紧预算[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]He tightened the lid of the jar so the food wouldn't go bad.[POS]v.[/POS]|他拧紧了瓶盖，让食物不会变质。[/EX][EX]The coach told the players to tighten their shoelaces.[POS]v.[/POS]|教练让球员们系紧鞋带。[/EX][EX]The dress tightens up when you sit down.[POS]v.[/POS]|你坐下时，裙子会变紧。[/EX][EX]The rope tightens up as the weight pulls it down.[POS]v.[/POS]|重物往下拉时，绳子会变紧。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]不要混淆 tighten 和 fasten！tighten 侧重“使已有的变得更紧”，fasten 侧重“将分开的固定在一起”，比如“扣上纽扣”是 fasten the button，“拉紧腰带”是 tighten the belt。[/ERR][ERR]作及物动词时直接接宾语，不要说“tighten up the rope”（虽可，但 tighten the rope 更简洁）。[/ERR][ERR]不要写成“tightenning”（错误拼写），正确现在分词形式是 tightening。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]A person who makes things by hand (used in the book when the castle workers make saddles for dragons)[/EN][CN]工匠；手艺人（书中指城堡里为龙制作鞍具的手工制作者）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈkrɑːftə(r)/（英式）/ˈkræftər/（美式）[/PH][DU]King Roland's crafters are making a saddle for each dragon.|(原文例句)罗兰德国王的工匠们正在给每条龙做马鞍。[/DU][DU]The crafter made a beautiful toy dragon with wood.|工匠用木头做了一个漂亮的玩具龙。[/DU][DU]My grandma is a crafter who knits warm sweaters.|我奶奶是个手艺人，会织温暖的毛衣。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/crafter.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]A skilled worker who creates things with their hands[/EN][CN]技艺精湛的手工创作者[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]The glass crafter made a shiny vase with colorful patterns.|玻璃工匠做了一个带有彩色花纹的闪亮花瓶。[/DU][DU]The leather crafter made a strong belt for the knight.|皮革工匠给骑士做了一条坚固的腰带。[/DU][DU]The crafter spent three days making the paper dragon.|工匠花了三天时间做这只纸龙。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]dragon saddle crafter|龙鞍具工匠[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The dragon saddle crafter works hard to make safe saddles.|龙鞍具工匠努力制作安全的鞍具。[/EX][EX]We visited the dragon saddle crafter's workshop.|我们参观了龙鞍具工匠的工坊。[/EX][C]a skilled dragon saddle crafter|熟练的龙鞍具工匠[/C][C]a hardworking dragon saddle crafter|勤劳的龙鞍具工匠[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]skilled crafter|熟练的手艺人[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]She is a skilled crafter who makes cloth dolls.|她是个熟练的手艺人，会做布娃娃。[/EX][EX]The skilled crafter can make many kinds of toys.|这个熟练的手艺人能做很多种玩具。[/EX][C]a skilled wood crafter|熟练的木雕工匠[/C][C]a skilled metal crafter|熟练的金属工匠[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The crafter in the castle is good at making metal tools.[POS]n.[/POS]|城堡里的工匠擅长做金属工具。[/EX][EX]The crafter used colorful threads to make the tapestry.[POS]n.[/POS]|工匠用彩色的线做了挂毯。[/EX][EX]We bought a handmade necklace from the crafter.|我们从手艺人那里买了一条手工项链。[/EX][EX]The crafter taught the kids how to make paper flowers.[POS]n.[/POS]|手艺人教孩子们如何做纸花。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]crafter 是可数名词，复数形式是 crafters，不要写成“craftman”（错误拼写），正确复数是 craftsmen（工匠们）。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆 crafter 和 artist！crafter 侧重“手工制作”，artist 侧重“艺术创作”，比如“画家”是 artist，“陶艺工匠”是 crafter。[/ERR][ERR]不要说“a crafter of wood”，正确表达是 a wood crafter（木雕工匠）。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]Having a thin and graceful body (used in the book when describing Kepri the Sun Dragon's body shape)[/EN][CN]纤细的；苗条的；修长的（书中用于描述太阳龙凯普丽的身材）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][PH]/slɪm/[/PH][DU]Kepri was a Sun Dragon with a slim body and white scales.|(原文例句)凯普丽是一条身材纤细、长着白色鳞片的太阳龙。[/DU][DU]The ballerina has a slim figure to dance easily.|芭蕾舞演员身材纤细，方便跳舞。[/DU][DU]The deer has slim legs that help it run fast.|小鹿有纤细的腿，能跑得很快。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/slim.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]Thin in a pleasant and healthy way[/EN][CN]苗条的；修长的（褒义，指健康好看的瘦）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][DU]The swan has a slim neck and white feathers.|天鹅有修长的脖子和白色的羽毛。[/DU][DU]My sister has a slim face with big eyes.|我姐姐有一张修长的脸，眼睛很大。[/DU][DU]The tree has slim branches that sway in the wind.|这棵树有纤细的树枝，在风中摇晃。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]slim body|纤细的身体[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The Sun Dragon has a slim body to fly quickly.|太阳龙有纤细的身体，能飞得很快。[/EX][EX]The fairy has a slim body that can fit through small gaps.|仙女有纤细的身体，能穿过小缝隙。[/EX][C]a slim body of a bird|小鸟纤细的身体[/C][C]a slim body of a dragon|龙纤细的身体[/C][/COLL][COLL][H]slim figure|苗条的身材[POS]adj.[/POS][/H][EX]The model has a slim figure that looks good in clothes.|模特身材苗条，穿衣服很好看。[/EX][EX]She keeps a slim figure by exercising every day.|她每天锻炼，保持苗条的身材。[/EX][C]a slim figure of a dancer|舞者苗条的身材[/C][C]a slim figure of a gymnast|体操运动员苗条的身材[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The slim snake moved quickly through the grass.[POS]adj.[/POS]|纤细的蛇快速地穿过草丛。[/EX][EX]The slim tree grows tall and straight in the garden.[POS]adj.[/POS]|这棵纤细的树在花园里长得又高又直。[/EX][EX]Her slim fingers can play the piano skillfully.[POS]adj.[/POS]|她纤细的手指能熟练地弹钢琴。[/EX][EX]The slim river flows gently through the village.[POS]adj.[/POS]|纤细的小河温柔地流过村庄。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]不要混淆 slim 和 thin！slim 侧重“纤细且优美”，是褒义；thin 可指“瘦的”，可能带“单薄”意味，比如“他太瘦了，看起来不健康”是 He is too thin and looks unhealthy，“她身材苗条，很优雅”是 She has a slim figure and is very elegant。[/ERR][ERR]不要说“slimly body”（错误），正确表达：slim body（纤细的身体），副词形式是 slimly，修饰动词，比如“slimly built”（身材纤细的）。[/ERR][ERR]slim 的比较级是 slimmer，最高级是 slimmest，不要写成“more slim”（错误）。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To make someone feel worried or upset (used in the book when Drake finds Bo is upset by something unknown)[/EN][CN]使烦恼；使不安（书中指德雷克发现有事情让波感到心烦意乱）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/ˈbɒðə(r)/（英式）/ˈbɑːðər/（美式）[/PH][DU]Drake could tell that something was bothering Bo.|(原文例句)德雷克能看出有什么事情在困扰着波。[/DU][DU]The loud noise bothers the little cat when it sleeps.|吵闹的声音会让睡觉的小猫感到烦躁。[/DU][DU]Don't bother him when he is doing his homework.|他做作业的时候不要打扰他。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/bother.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To take the time or effort to do something[/EN][CN]费心；麻烦（做某事）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]She didn't bother to close the window before leaving.|她离开前懒得费心去关窗户。[/DU][DU]I won't bother to buy that toy, it's too expensive.|我懒得费心买那个玩具，它太贵了。[/DU][DU]He never bothers to say hello to his classmates.|他从不费心和同学们打招呼。[/DU][/DEF][DEF][EN]A feeling of worry or slight trouble[/EN][CN]烦恼；小麻烦[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][DU]It's just a little bother, don't worry about it.|这只是个小麻烦，别担心。[/DU][DU]She had a lot of bother with her broken bike.|她的自行车坏了，给她添了很多麻烦。[/DU][DU]The little boy is such a bother when he cries all day.|小男孩整天哭，真是个小麻烦。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]A regular arrangement of lines, shapes, colours, etc.; a way of doing something that is repeated regularly (used in the book when Bo found the repeated line design on the magic box)[/EN][CN]图案；花纹；模式；方式；规律（书中指波发现魔法盒子上重复的线条纹路）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈpætn/（英式）/ˈpeɪtərn/（美式）[/PH][DU]Bo found a strange star pattern on the bottom of the magic box with the red dust.|(原文例句)波在装着红色粉末的魔法盒底部，发现了一个奇怪的星星图案。[/DU][DU]The water dragon's scales have a blue wave pattern, which is unique to water dragons.|水龙的鳞片有蓝色的波浪花纹，这是水龙独有的特征。[/DU][DU]The Raven Guard always follow the same attack pattern, so we can find their weakness easily.|乌鸦卫队总是遵循相同的攻击模式，所以我们能轻易找到他们的弱点。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/pattern.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To make something with a regular arrangement of shapes, colours, etc.[/EN][CN]给……加上图案；用图案装饰[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The wizard patterned the magic wand with dragon carvings to make it more powerful.|巫师在魔法棒上刻上龙的图案作装饰，让它的力量更强。[/DU][DU]She patterned the dragon saddle with golden threads and it looked very beautiful.|她用金线给龙鞍绣上图案，看起来十分精美。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The magic carpet has a colorful dragon pattern and it can fly faster when the pattern glows.[POS]n.[/POS]|魔法地毯有彩色的龙纹图案，图案发光时地毯能飞得更快。[/EX][EX]This pattern of using magic crystals to power the castle has been used for hundreds of years.[POS]n.[/POS]|这种用魔法晶石为城堡供能的方式已经沿用了数百年。[/EX][EX]He patterned the wooden box with the symbol of the dragon kingdom and gave it to the king as a gift.[POS]v.[/POS]|他仿照龙之国的标志给木盒刻上图案，把它当作礼物送给了国王。[/EX][EX]The little girl patterned her notebook with small dragon drawings and showed it to her dragon master teacher.[POS]v.[/POS]|小女孩在笔记本上画满小龙图案作装饰，拿给她的龙法师老师看。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]pattern作名词“模式、规律”时，是可数名词，不要说in pattern of（错误），正确是in a pattern of / in the pattern of。[/ERR][ERR]pattern作动词时，固定搭配是pattern sth with sth，不要用by代替with（错误：pattern the box by stars），正确是pattern the box with stars。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆pattern和design！pattern侧重“重复出现的、有规律的图案或模式”；design侧重“为特定目的设计的图案、构思、设计方案”，如a check pattern / a new design for the dragon saddle。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]A tall, straight stone or metal post that supports a building; a long, narrow upright section of something; a line of people or things moving together (used in the book when the Raven Guard moved in a straight line toward the castle gate)[/EN][CN]柱；柱子；圆柱；列；纵队（书中指乌鸦卫队排成一列纵队朝城堡大门移动）[/CN][POS]n.[/POS][PH]/ˈkɒləm/（英式）/ˈkɑːləm/（美式）[/PH][DU]A column of Raven Guard marched toward the castle gate, holding their dark magic wands.|(原文例句)一队乌鸦卫队手持黑魔法棒，排成纵队朝城堡大门行进。[/DU][DU]A huge stone column in the castle hall supports the golden roof of the dragon kingdom.|城堡大厅里的一根巨大石柱，支撑着龙之国的金色屋顶。[/DU][DU]There is a column of magic writing on the wall, which only dragon masters can understand.|墙上有一列魔法文字，只有龙法师能看懂。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/column.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]a column of sth|一列……；一队……；一根……柱[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]A column of smoke rose from the magic forest, which meant there was a fire there.|一缕烟从魔法森林升起，说明那里着火了。[/EX][EX]A column of dragons flew across the sky, heading for the Valley of Clouds together.|一队龙排成列飞过天空，一同前往云谷。[/EX][C]a column of soldiers|一队士兵[/C][C]a stone column|石柱[/C][C]a column of water|一股水柱[/C][/COLL][H]in column|排成纵队[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The young dragon masters marched in column to the training ground, following their teacher.|年轻的龙法师们跟着老师，排成纵队走向训练场。[/EX][EX]The magic wolves moved in column through the forest, not daring to make any noise.|魔法狼排成纵队穿过森林，不敢发出一点声响。[/EX][C]in single column|排成单列[/C][C]in double column|排成双列[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The wizard used magic to repair the broken marble column in the castle courtyard.[POS]n.[/POS]|巫师用魔法修复了城堡庭院里断裂的大理石柱。[/EX][EX]A column of golden light shot from the Dragon Stone and lit up the dark cave.[POS]n.[/POS]|一道金光从龙石中射出，照亮了黑暗的洞穴。[/EX][EX]We can see a column of names of great dragon masters on the stone wall of the castle.[POS]n.[/POS]|我们能在城堡的石墙上看到一列伟大龙法师的名字。[/EX][EX]A column of carriages carrying magic crystals moved slowly toward the castle gate.[POS]n.[/POS]|一队装载着魔法晶石的马车，缓缓朝城堡大门移动。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]column作“纵队、列”时，固定搭配是a column of sth，不要少了a，也不要说column sth（错误：column soldiers），正确是a column of soldiers。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆column和row！column是**竖列**，指垂直方向的一排；row是**横排**，指水平方向的一排，如a column of words（竖列文字）/ a row of chairs（横排椅子）。[/ERR][ERR]column作“柱子”时，是可数名词，表达“一根柱子”用a column，“多根柱子”用columns，不要说many column（错误）。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To take action to solve a problem or deal with a difficult person or situation (used in the book when Griffith told the team how to take action against the Raven Guard)[/EN][CN]处理；应对；对付；解决（书中指格里菲斯告诉队员们如何对付乌鸦卫队）[/CN][POS]v. phr.[/POS][PH]/diːl wɪð/[/PH][DU]"We need to deal with the Raven Guard before they use the red dust for dark magic," Griffith said.|(原文例句)格里菲斯说：“我们必须在乌鸦卫队用红色粉末施展黑魔法前，先对付他们。”[/DU][DU]The wizard taught us how to deal with dark magic spells with our dragon's power.|巫师教我们如何用龙的力量应对黑魔法咒语。[/DU][DU]It's not easy to deal with the magic monsters in the dark forest, for they are very fierce.|处理黑森林里的魔法怪兽并不容易，因为它们十分凶猛。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/deal with.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To be about something; to relate to something[/EN][CN]涉及；关于[/CN][POS]v. phr.[/POS][DU]This magic book deals with the history of dragons and their bond with humans.|这本魔法书讲述的是龙的历史以及它们和人类的羁绊。[/DU][DU]The new spell we learned today deals with how to heal injured dragons quickly.|我们今天学的新咒语，是关于如何快速医治受伤的龙。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]deal with a problem/situation|处理问题/应对情况[POS]v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]We need to find a way to deal with the magic fog that blocks the path to the dragon cave.|我们需要找到方法处理阻挡龙穴道路的魔法雾。[/EX][EX]Ana is very good at dealing with difficult young dragons, for she is patient and kind.|安娜很擅长应对调皮的小龙，因为她既耐心又善良。[/EX][C]deal with the enemy|对付敌人[/C][C]deal with the crisis|应对危机[/C][/COLL][H]deal with sb|对付某人；和某人打交道[POS]v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]It's dangerous to deal with the dark wizard, for he has powerful black magic.|和黑巫师打交道很危险，因为他拥有强大的黑魔法。[/EX][EX]He doesn't like to deal with rude people, even if they are powerful dragon masters.|他不喜欢和粗鲁的人打交道，就算对方是强大的龙法师也一样。[/EX][/COLL][H]deal with sth/sb|涉及/关于某事/某人[POS]v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]This chapter of the book deals with how to make a magic bond with a baby dragon.|这本书的这一章讲的是如何和小龙建立魔法羁绊。[/EX][EX]The speech the king gave today deals with the protection of the Dragon Stone.|国王今天的演讲，是关于龙石的守护工作。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The dragon master used a special potion to deal with the poison on the dragon's paw.[POS]v. phr.[/POS]|龙法师用一种特殊药剂，处理掉了龙爪子上的毒素。[/EX][EX]We have to deal with the broken magic barrier first, or the dark magic will come into the castle.[POS]v. phr.[/POS]|我们必须先处理破损的魔法屏障，否则黑魔法会侵入城堡。[/EX][EX]This magic course deals with the basic skills of controlling water dragons for beginners.[POS]v. phr.[/POS]|这门魔法课程，是为初学者开设的、关于操控水龙的基础技巧。[/EX][EX]He has a lot of experience in dealing with the problems between humans and dragons.[POS]v. phr.[/POS]|他在处理人和龙之间的矛盾问题上，有很多经验。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]deal with是**固定短语动词**，不能随意拆分，也不能用do代替deal（错误：do with the problem），表达“处理问题”常用deal with a problem，do with多和what搭配（what to do with）。[/ERR][ERR]询问“如何处理”时，用**how** to deal with，不要用what（错误：what to deal with the enemy），正确是what to do with the enemy / how to deal with the enemy。[/ERR][ERR]deal的过去式和过去分词是dealt，不要记错成dealed（错误：We have dealed with the problem），正确是We have dealt with the problem。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To not succeed in doing something; to not be able to do something; to stop working correctly (used in the book when the magic shield stopped working against the Raven Guard's dust)[/EN][CN]失败；未能；未能做到；失灵；失效（书中指魔法屏障在乌鸦卫队的粉末面前失去了作用）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][PH]/feɪl/[/PH][DU]The magic shield around the castle failed to stop the red dust from spreading in the air.|(原文例句)城堡周围的魔法屏障没能阻止红色粉末在空气中扩散。[/DU][DU]We failed to catch the Raven Guard at the forest gate, and they ran into the dark woods.|我们在森林门口没能抓住乌鸦卫队，他们逃进了黑森林。[/DU][DU]The magic crystal in the wand failed, so I can't cast any spells for the moment.|魔法棒里的晶石失灵了，所以我暂时无法施展任何咒语。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/fail.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To not pass an exam or a test[/EN][CN]不及格；未通过（考试）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]No one has ever failed the dragon master test in the kingdom for ten years.|十年来，王国里从来没有人未通过龙法师的考核。[/DU][DU]He was afraid he would fail the magic spell test, so he practiced day and night.|他害怕自己魔法咒语考试不及格，所以日夜练习。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]fail to do sth|未能做某事；没能做到某事[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The young dragon failed to fly over the magic mountain, so it had to go around it.|小龙没能飞过魔法山，所以只能绕路走。[/EX][EX]We must not fail to protect the Dragon Stone, or the whole kingdom will be in danger.|我们绝不能守护不住龙石，否则整个王国都会陷入危险。[/EX][C]fail to keep a promise|未能遵守承诺[/C][C]fail to arrive on time|未能按时到达[/C][/COLL][H]fail in sth|在某事上失败；未通过某事[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]He failed in the dragon training test, but he decided to try again next year.|他在龙术训练考核中失败了，但他决定明年再试一次。[/EX][EX]The dark wizard failed in his plan to steal the Dragon Stone, and he was driven out of the kingdom.|黑巫师偷取龙石的计划失败了，他被赶出了王国。[/EX][C]fail in an exam|考试不及格[/C][/COLL][H]sth fail (sb)|某物失灵；某物让某人失望[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]My magic wand failed me in the fight, and I had to use my dragon's power to defend myself.|我的魔法棒在战斗中失灵了，我只能用龙的力量自卫。[/EX][EX]The magic light failed us in the dark cave, and we lost our way for a while.|魔法灯在黑暗的洞穴里熄灭了，我们迷路了一会儿。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The magic lock failed and the door of the dragon cave opened by itself suddenly.[POS]v.[/POS]|魔法锁失灵了，龙穴的门突然自己打开了。[/EX][EX]She failed to wake up the sleeping dragon, even though she used all her magic spells.[POS]v.[/POS]|尽管用尽了所有魔法咒语，她还是没能唤醒沉睡的龙。[/EX][EX]If you don't practice the spell every day, you will fail in the final magic test.[POS]v.[/POS]|如果你不每天练习咒语，你会在最终的魔法考试中不及格。[/EX][EX]The bridge made of magic wood failed under the heavy rain, and we had to cross the river by dragon.[POS]v.[/POS]|魔法木桥在大雨中坍塌了，我们只能骑龙过河。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]fail后接“做某事”时，必须用**fail to do sth**，不要用fail doing sth（错误：We failed catching the enemy），正确是We failed to catch the enemy。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆fail和lose！fail侧重“未能做到某事、失灵、考试不及格”；lose侧重“失去某物、输掉比赛/战争”，如fail the test / lose the fight。[/ERR][ERR]fail作“不及格”时，是及物动词，可说fail the exam，也可说fail in the exam，但不要说fail to the exam（错误）。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To have the courage to do something difficult or dangerous; to be brave enough to do something (used as a modal verb or a main verb) (used in the book when Bo wondered if he had the courage to go into the dark cave)[/EN][CN]敢；胆敢；有勇气做（困难/危险的事）（可作情态动词或实义动词，书中指波不确定自己是否有勇气走进黑森林的洞穴）[/CN][POS]v./modal v.[/POS][PH]/deə(r)/（英式）/der/（美式）[/PH][DU]"Do you dare to go into the dark cave with me to find the Raven Guard?" Griffith asked Bo.|(原文例句)格里菲斯问波：“你敢和我一起走进黑洞穴找乌鸦卫队吗？”[/DU][DU]No one in the kingdom dares to challenge the fire dragon, for it is the most powerful dragon.|王国里没人敢挑战火龙，因为它是最强大的龙。[/DU][DU]She daren't use dark magic, even if it can help her win the dragon master test.|她不敢使用黑魔法，就算它能帮她赢得龙法师考核。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/dare.webp[/IMG][DEF][EN]To challenge someone to do something, especially something difficult or dangerous[/EN][CN]激将；挑战某人做（难事）[/CN][POS]v.[/POS][DU]The Raven Guard dared Bo to steal the Dragon Stone, saying he was too scared to do it.|乌鸦卫队激波去偷龙石，说他根本没胆子做。[/DU][DU]He dared me to fly the dragon through the storm, and I accepted his challenge.|他激我骑着龙穿过暴风雨，我接受了他的挑战。[/DU][/DEF]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]dare to do sth（实义动词）|敢做某事[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]Do you dare to touch the magic crystal that glows red in the dark?|你敢碰那颗在黑暗中发红光的魔法晶石吗？[/EX][EX]He doesn't dare to tell the wizard about his mistake, for he is afraid of being punished.|他不敢把自己的错误告诉巫师，因为害怕被惩罚。[/EX][C]dare sb to do sth|激某人做某事[/C][/COLL][H]dare do sth/daren't do sth（情态动词）|敢做某事/不敢做某事[POS]modal v.[/POS][/H][EX]No one dare enter the magic cave alone, for there are many terrible monsters in it.|没人敢独自进入魔法洞穴，因为里面有很多可怕的怪兽。[/EX][EX]She daren't fly the dragon at night, because she is afraid of the dark.|她不敢在夜里骑龙，因为她怕黑。[/EX][C]How dare you...?|你竟敢……？（表愤怒）[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]How dare you hurt the baby dragon? The dragon master will punish you for this.[POS]modal v.[/POS]|你竟敢伤害小龙？龙法师会为此惩罚你的。[/EX][EX]He dares to practice magic spells in the forbidden forest, even though it's against the rules.|他竟敢在禁林里练习魔法咒语，尽管这违反了规定。[/EX][EX]The little boy dared his friend to sit on the back of the small dragon, and both of them were very excited.[POS]v.[/POS]|小男孩激他的朋友坐到小龙背上，两人都特别兴奋。[/EX][EX]She daren't tell anyone about the secret she found in the castle tower.[POS]modal v.[/POS]|她不敢把在城堡塔楼发现的秘密告诉任何人。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]dare作**情态动词**时，仅用于否定句、疑问句和条件句，后接**动词原形**，不要加to（错误：She daren't to go），正确是She daren't go；作**实义动词**时，后接**to do sth**，否定式用don't/doesn't/didn't dare to do。[/ERR][ERR]How dare you...? 是固定句式，后接动词原形（错误：How dare you to do that），正确是How dare you do that？[/ERR][ERR]dare的过去式是dared，过去分词也是dared，作实义动词时，过去式否定为didn't dare to do（不要说dared not to do）。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]Feeling dizzy and sick, as if you are going to faint; feeling confused and not able to think clearly (used in the book when Ana felt dizzy after breathing in the red dust)[/EN][CN]头晕的；昏沉的；发晕的；神志不清的（书中指安娜吸入红色粉末后感到头晕目眩）[/CN][POS]adj.[/POS][PH]/ˈwuːzi/[/PH][DU]Ana felt woozy after breathing in a little of the red dust, and she had to hold on to Kepri's neck.|(原文例句)安娜吸入了一点红色粉末后感到头晕，只能紧紧抓住凯普丽的脖子。[/DU][DU]After flying on the dragon for hours, I felt a little woozy and wanted to land at once.|骑龙飞了几个小时后，我感到有点昏沉，想立刻降落。[/DU][DU]He hit his head on the stone column and felt woozy for a few minutes.|他的头撞到了石柱上，晕乎乎了好几分钟。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/woozy.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]sb is + adj. + by nature|某人天生……；某人本性上是……[POS]adv. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]The water dragon is gentle by nature, and it never hurts small animals in the magic lake.|水龙本性温顺，从不伤害魔法湖里的小动物。[/EX][EX]He is honest by nature, so he will never lie about the location of the Dragon Stone to the Raven Guard.|他天生诚实，绝不会向乌鸦卫队谎报龙石的位置。[/EX][C]be kind by nature|天生善良[/C][C]be brave by nature|天生勇敢[/C][/COLL][H]by nature, sb/sth + v.|本性上，某人/某物会……；天生，某人/某物……[POS]adv. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]By nature, fire dragons are hot-tempered, so you need to be patient when training them.|本性上，火龙脾气暴躁，所以训练它们时你需要有耐心。[/EX][EX]By nature, magic birds like to fly in the clear sky, and they hate the misty air made by dark magic.|天生，魔法鸟喜欢在晴朗的天空飞翔，讨厌黑魔法制造的雾气弥漫的空气。[/EX][/COLL][H]act by nature|凭本性行事；出于本能行动[POS]adv. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]The baby dragon acted by nature and hid behind its master when it saw the strange dark monster.|小龙崽出于本能行动，看到陌生的黑暗怪兽就躲到了主人身后。[/EX][EX]When in danger, dragons will act by nature and use their power to protect their masters.|遇到危险时，龙会凭本性行事，用自己的力量保护主人。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]She is creative by nature, and she always makes unique magic toys for the baby dragons in the castle.|她天生富有创造力，总为城堡里的小龙崽制作独一无二的魔法玩具。[/EX][EX]By nature, the magic wolf is a social animal, and it lives in groups with other wolves in the forest.|本性上，魔法狼是群居动物，会和森林里的其他狼一起成群生活。[/EX][EX]He is careful by nature, so he never makes mistakes when mixing magic potions for the dragons.|他天生细心，为龙调配魔法药剂时从不出错。[/EX][EX]By nature, all living things in the dragon kingdom love peace, and they hate the wars caused by the Raven Guard.|天生，龙之国的所有生灵都热爱和平，厌恶乌鸦卫队挑起的战争。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]by nature是**固定副词短语**，**不能随意拆分或替换单词**（错误：by the nature / in nature），in nature表“本质上；在自然界中”，和by nature含义不同，需区分。[/ERR][ERR]by nature在句中多作**状语**，可放在句首、句中或句末，放在句首时后面常用逗号隔开（正确：By nature, he is brave.），不要遗漏逗号。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆by nature和naturally！by nature侧重“天生的、本性的特质，从出生就具备的”；naturally侧重“自然而然地，顺理成章地，或天生地（可通用）”，但by nature更强调“本性本质”，如He is kind by nature / He naturally knows how to talk to dragons。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To become gradually quieter and then stop; to become less clear or stop suddenly when speaking; to move slowly away into the distance[/EN][CN]（声音）逐渐变弱直至消失；（说话）声音渐低而止；话语断断续续；慢慢消失在远方；渐行渐远[/CN][POS]v. phr.[/POS][PH]/treɪl ɒf/（英式）/treɪl ɔːf/（美式）[/PH][DU]Bo's voice trailed off when he saw the huge Raven Guard standing in front of him, and he couldn't say another word.|(原文例句)波看到高大的乌鸦卫队站在自己面前，声音渐渐低了下去，一句话也说不出来了。[/DU][DU]The red light from the magic dust trailed off into the misty air, and we could no longer see where it went.|红色粉末发出的红光在雾蒙蒙的空气中渐渐消失，我们再也看不到它飘向了哪里。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/trail-off.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]one's voice trail off|某人的声音渐渐变弱；某人说话渐低而止[POS]v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]Her voice trailed off when she talked about the lost baby dragon, and she was too sad to continue.|谈到走失的小龙崽时，她的声音渐渐低了下去，悲伤得无法继续说下去。[/EX][EX]The young dragon master's voice trailed off when he was asked about his fight with the dark wizard, for he was ashamed of his failure.|当被问到和黑巫师的战斗时，这位年轻龙法师的声音渐渐变弱，因为他为自己的失败感到羞愧。[/EX][C]trail off into silence|声音渐低直至沉默[/C][/COLL][H]sth trail off (into sp)|某物渐渐消失在（某处）；某物渐行渐远至（某处）[POS]v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]The magic birds flew toward the misty mountain, and their figures trailed off into the white fog.|魔法鸟朝云雾缭绕的山飞去，身影渐渐消失在白雾中。[/EX][EX]The path trail off into the dark forest, and no one dares to walk further alone.|这条路慢慢消失在黑森林深处，没人敢独自往前走。[/EX][/COLL][H]trail off (when doing sth)|（做某事时）声音渐低；（做某事时）渐渐消失[POS]v. phr.[/POS][/H][EX]He trailed off when he was explaining the magic spell, because he forgot the next step.|他讲解魔法咒语时突然语塞，因为忘了接下来的步骤。[/EX][EX]The glow from the Dragon Stone trailed off when the dark magic came near, as if it was hiding its power.|当黑魔法靠近时，龙石发出的光芒渐渐变弱，仿佛在隐藏自己的力量。[/EX][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The sound of the dragon's roar trailed off into the distance, and the forest became quiet again.|龙的咆哮声渐渐消失在远方，森林又恢复了平静。[/EX][EX]His voice trailed off into silence when he saw the wizard standing behind him, for he was talking about him secretly.|看到巫师站在自己身后，他的声音渐渐低至沉默，因为他正在偷偷议论对方。[/EX][EX]The small boat sailed on the misty lake, and its wake trailed off into the calm water.|小船在雾蒙蒙的湖面上航行，船尾的水痕渐渐消失在平静的水中。[/EX][EX]She trailed off when she was asked to sing the dragon song, because she was too nervous in front of all the dragon masters.|被要求唱龙之歌时，她的歌声渐渐弱了下去，因为在所有龙法师面前她太紧张了。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]trail off是**不及物短语动词**，后面**不能直接接宾语**，表示“声音渐低”直接用one's voice trail off，无需加宾语；表示“消失在某处”需加介词into（正确：trail off into the fog）。[/ERR][ERR]trail off的过去式是**trailed off**，不要记错成trail offed（错误），也不要拆分写（错误：trailed it off），该短语无被动形式。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆trail off和die down！二者都表“逐渐变弱”，trail off侧重“声音、身影、痕迹的渐渐消失，或说话的语塞渐低”；die down侧重“声音、火焰、风暴、情绪等的逐渐平息、减弱”，如her voice trailed off / the fire died down slowly。[/ERR]

[TITLE]解释[/TITLE][DEF][EN]To do something even though it may be dangerous or have bad results; the possibility of something bad or dangerous happening[/EN][CN]冒险做；冒……的险（明知可能有危险或不良后果仍去做）；风险；危险（坏事或危险发生的可能性）[/CN][POS]v./n.[/POS][PH]/rɪsk/[/PH][DU]Griffith decided to risk entering the misty dark forest alone, for he had to find the Raven Guard before they used the red dust.|(原文例句)格里菲斯决定冒险独自进入雾蒙蒙的黑森林，因为他必须在乌鸦卫队使用红色粉末前找到他们。[/DU][DU]There is a great risk that the red dust will spread to the castle if we don't stop the Raven Guard in time.|如果我们不及时阻止乌鸦卫队，红色粉末很有可能扩散到城堡里。[/DU][/DEF][IMG]infopic01/risk.webp[/IMG]

[TITLE]常见用法[/TITLE][COLL][H]risk doing sth|冒险做某事[POS]v.[/POS][/H][EX]The young dragon master risked touching the hot magic crystal to get the healing potion inside for his injured dragon.|这位年轻的龙法师冒险触碰滚烫的魔法晶石，只为拿到里面的疗伤药剂给受伤的龙。[/EX][EX]She risked flying the dragon in the storm to send the magic letter to the wizard in the Cloud Valley.|她冒着暴风雨骑龙飞行，只为把魔法信送到云谷的巫师手中。[/EX][/COLL][H]take a risk (in doing sth)|（做某事时）冒险；冒一次险[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]We have to take a risk in crossing the magic river at night, because the Raven Guard is chasing us from behind.|我们不得不冒险在夜里渡过魔法河，因为乌鸦卫队正在身后追赶我们。[/EX][EX]He took a big risk in using the forbidden magic to save the dragon, and he almost lost his own magic power.|他冒险使用禁术拯救龙，差点失去自己的魔力。[/EX][C]take the risk of doing sth|冒做某事的风险[/C][/COLL][H]a risk (that)...|……的风险；有可能……[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]There is a small risk that the magic potion will make the dragon sleepy for a few hours, but it's not dangerous.|这瓶魔法药剂有可能让龙昏睡几个小时，但并不危险。[/EX][EX]There is no risk that the Dragon Stone will be stolen if we keep it in the magic shield.|如果把龙石放在魔法屏障里，就没有被偷走的风险。[/EX][C]a great/big risk|巨大的风险[/C][C]no risk|没有风险[/C][/COLL][H]at risk|处于危险中；有风险[POS]n.[/POS][/H][EX]The baby dragons are at risk if they stay in the misty forest alone, because there are many dark monsters there.|小龙崽如果独自待在雾蒙蒙的森林里，会处于危险之中，因为那里有很多黑暗怪兽。[/EX][EX]Your magic power will be at risk if you breathe in too much red dust from the Raven Guard.|如果你吸入过多乌鸦卫队的红色粉末，你的魔力会面临受损的风险。[/EX][C]put sb/sth at risk|使某人/某物处于危险中[/C][/COLL]

[TITLE]额外例句[/TITLE][EX]The wizard warned us not to risk going to the forbidden cave, for it's full of powerful dark magic.|巫师警告我们不要冒险去禁洞，因为里面充满了强大的黑魔法。[/EX][EX]He risked his life to protect the baby dragon from the fire monster, and all the dragon masters admired him for it.|他冒着生命危险保护小龙崽免受火焰怪兽的伤害，所有龙法师都为此敬佩他。[/EX][EX]There is no need to take a risk, we can use the Finding Feather to find the Raven Guard safely.|没必要冒险，我们可以用寻踪羽毛安全地找到乌鸦卫队。[/EX][EX]Putting the Dragon Stone outside the magic shield will put the whole dragon kingdom at risk.|把龙石放在魔法屏障外面，会让整个龙之国处于危险之中。[/EX]

[TITLE]常见错误[/TITLE][ERR]risk作动词时，固定搭配是**risk doing sth**，**绝对不能接to do sth**（错误：risk to enter the forest），这是最核心易错点，正确是risk entering the forest。[/ERR][ERR]risk作名词“风险”时，可作可数或不可数名词，表“一种风险”用a risk，表“多种风险”用risks；take a risk是固定搭配，a不可少（错误：take risk），正确是take a risk。[/ERR][ERR]不要混淆risk和danger！risk侧重“可能发生危险的**概率或风险**，也可作动词表冒险”；danger侧重“实际存在的**危险、险境**，仅作名词”，如There is a risk of danger / The dragon is in great danger。[/ERR][ERR]at risk是固定短语，**不加the**（错误：at the risk）；the risk of doing sth 中必须加the，表“做某事的风险”。[/ERR]
